author: Ari Koslow
title: Vinnie Pasquantino (hand) on track to begin rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Vinnie Pasquantino remains on track to begin a rehab assignment with Triple-A Omaha on Tuesday.
impact: Pasquantino will likely figure to play in at least a handful of rehab games. He could be activated shortly after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Isbel (foot) not ready for rehab assignment
desc: Kyle Isbel will not be going on a rehab assignment as expected on Tuesday.
impact: Isbel has been feeling soreness while running over the weekend. He's being re-evaluated on Monday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Martin Perez (forearm) placed on IL
desc: The Braves placed Martín Pérez on the 15-day injured list with a left forearm contusion.
impact: Perez exited his most recent start over the weekend with the injury. He does not hold a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: JR Ritchie recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Braves recalled JR Ritchie from Triple-A Gwinnett.
impact: Ritchie returns one day after he was optioned. He'll likely remain in a bullpen role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carlos Carrasco designated for assignment
desc: The Braves designated Carlos Carrasco for assignment.
impact: Carrasco will head back to waivers again as he loses his spot on the Braves 40-man roster.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Owen Murphy has contract selected by Braves
desc: The Braves selected the contract of RHP Owen Murphy to the majors.
impact: Murphy underwent Tommy John surgery back in 2024. He was a top prospect for Atlanta prior to his injury.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Trey Yesavage takes tough-luck loss versus Mariners Sunday
desc: Blue Jays right-hander Trey Yesavage pitched six innings, allowing three runs (two earned) while taking the loss on Sunday against the Mariners.
impact: For the second straight game, the Blue Jays were shut out by Mariners pitching, recording only five hits in that time. As a result, Yesavage was dealt a tough-luck loss despite throwing a quality start, allowing just three hits and two walks while striking out seven. The 22-year-old owns a 3.31 ERA through 13 starts this season, and lines up to take on the Padres on the road this weekend.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Emilio Pagan allows run, earns save over Orioles Sunday
desc: Reds right-hander Emilio Pagan allowed one earned run in one inning of work while picking up the save in a 3-2 win over the Orioles on Sunday.
impact: Pagan issued a pair of walks and allowed a single to load the bases with just one out in the ninth. He surrendered a sacrifice fly to Gunnar Henderson before an Adley Rutschman line drive was hauled in by TJ Friedl in center field to end the game. It was a bump frame, but Pagan earned his seventh save of the season, and his first since returning from the injured list on Friday. The 35-year-old ports a 6.46 ERA in 17 outings this season, but manager Terry Francona said Pagan has the ninth inning for the time being.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Roman Anthony (hand/wrist) to visit specialist this week
desc: Roman Anthony is scheduled to visit with a hand specialist this week.
impact: Anthony has seemingly made very little progress in his recovery. There should be an update on his status by the end of the week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Blake Snell (elbow) to throw another bullpen
desc: Blake Snell is scheduled to throw another bullpen.
impact: Snell recently threw a bullpen in late June. He should be nearing the corner of facing live hitters.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Nick Lodolo hurls quality start, earns win over Orioles Sunday
desc: Reds left-hander Nick Lodolo pitched six innings, allowing one earned run on six hits and two walks while earning the win over the Orioles on Sunday.
impact: Nodolo was solid in this one, holding the I's to just one earned run, which didn't come until an RBI single off the bat of Coby Mayo in the sixth inning. He allowed six hits in total, five of which were singles, and a pair of walks against four strikeouts on the afternoon. Lodolo has allowed just one earned run over his last three starts, spanning 15 innings of work with just nine hits and seven walks allowed against 14 strikeouts in that time. The southpaw will take a 4.68 ERA into his next scheduled start, which will come at home against the Cubs on the weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Spencer Horwitz (hamstring) expected to return in July
desc: Pirates GM Ben Cherington said that Spencer Horwitz is expected back in July.
impact: Horwitz will be sidelined through the All-Star break, but he is progressing as he continues his rehab in Florida. He could be ready to begin a rehab assignment within the next week or two.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Oneil Cruz (hand) expected to return in July
desc: Pirates GM Ben Cherington said that Oneil Cruz is expected back in July.
impact: Cruz will be sidelined through the All-Star break, but he is progressing as he continues his rehab in Florida. He could be ready to begin a rehab assignment within the next week or two.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Spencer Steer homers in win over Orioles Sunday
desc: Reds infielder Spencer Steer went 1-for-3 with a two-run homer in a 3-2 win over the Orioles on Sunday.
impact: Steer opened the scoring in this one, taking Orioles starter Kyle Bradish deep for a two-run homer in the fifth inning, his 14th long ball of the season. The 28-year-old has been fairly quiet of late, recording just one multi-hit game since June 2, but has still slashed a decent .238/.317/.422 with 14 homers 50 runs, 36 RBI, and three stolen bases across 85 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Bloss (elbow) throws 4 1/3 innings in rehab start
desc: Jake Bloss allowed one run on three hits in 4 1/3 innings for Triple-A Buffalo on Sunday.
impact: Bloss added one strikeout and one walk in the outing. It is unclear if he'll require one more rehab start or not.
